message: Hello, I want to order an automation that syncs new Shopify orders to Google Sheets every hour. Can you build that?
draft_reply: Hi, thank you for your message! Yes, I can build that automation for you — syncing new orders to Google Sheets on a schedule is exactly the kind of workflow I set up. Please message me before ordering with your store details and how often you want the sync to run, and I will confirm the plan and timeline.
